headline: Huawei Circumvents US Sanctions with Indigenous SSD Packaging, Advancing China's Chip Independence
summary: Huawei's successful production of 122TB SSDs using proprietary packaging demonstrates China's increasing ability to overcome US semiconductor export controls, directly impacting the efficacy of current sanctions. This development significantly accelerates China's domestic AI infrastructure capabilities and forces a re-evaluation of global tech supply chain dependencies and geopolitical strategies aimed at containing Beijing's technological rise.
